name: Buy Desk
office_task: Buy the materials for one job from stock first and the supplier's own prices, release only under the money rules, and check every delivery docket back.
systems_of_record: the job system that issues the job_id and holds its material list and stock
the supplier portal or job-system purchasing that issues each order's external id

emits.write: one purchase order per job and supplier, released by the named rule under its threshold to an approved supplier (or by a named person), carrying the job_id, the catalogue edition and the release
emits.readback: the ordering system returns the order's external id, and reading the job's orders back by job_id returns that external id with the supplier, the lines and the release; no external id back is a failed write, raised to a person, and nothing is sent

emits.write: the delivery docket matched to its sent order line by line, with the quantity received and a reason (short, damaged, substituted) on any line that differs
emits.readback: reading the job's record back by job_id returns the delivery on the order's id with one line per ordered line; a docket naming no sent order is never recorded and is raised instead

emits.write: an exception on the job or the order naming the person who owns it: an order waiting for a named release (over the threshold, or to a supplier not on the approved list), a code no catalogue holds, an order write with no id back, a docket that matches no sent order, and every delivery variance (short, over, wrong item, changed price, unaccepted substitution)
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the job_id, the order's external id where one exists, the kind and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops
